title: Shawn Michaels vs. The Undertaker: career vs. streak
summary: Unable to accept his WrestleMania defeat, Michaels pursues another attempt to end Undertaker’s streak. The rematch puts his own career at stake.

chapters.title: Undertaker survives Michaels’ challenge
chapters.context: The close contest drives Michaels’ pursuit of a rematch.

chapters.title: The streak costs Michaels his career
chapters.result: Undertaker defeats Michaels in the career-versus-streak match.
chapters.context: Michaels ends his full-time in-ring career; a later one-off return is outside this arc.
